ValidationRule.description: IMC Setup Date has to be today's date. It cannot be in the Past or the Future. For reference, check user story #26355 on Gitlab.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ((RecordType_Name__c = "NCSP: SKP New Customer Setup") || (RecordType_Name__c = "NCSP: SKP Department Add Only") || (RecordType_Name__c = "NCSP: DP New Customer Setup") || (RecordType_Name__c = "NCSP: DMS") || (RecordType_Name__c = "NCSP: New Customer Setup") )&& OR( ( NOT(ISCHANGED(Open_Tasks__c)) && ISCHANGED(IMC_Setup_Date__c) && NOT(ISBLANK(IMC_Setup_Date__c)) && DATEVALUE(IMC_Setup_Date__c) != TODAY() && ( ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(IMC_Setup_Date__c)) || DATEVALUE(IMC_Setup_Date__c) != DATEVALUE(PRIORVALUE(IMC_Setup_Date__c)) ) ), ( ISNEW() && NOT(ISBLANK(IMC_Setup_Date__c)) && DATEVALUE(IMC_Setup_Date__c) != TODAY() ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: IMC Setup Date has to be today's date. It cannot be in the Past or the Future.
